payload.description:
## Expected
Scoped --reference-id sync updates vectors for one reference without shrinking the corpus lexical artifact.

## Observed
sync --reference-id <one> --force rebuilt lexical to that one ref (and with --no-passage-vectors wrote skipped_empty). Full-corpus sync required to restore docs=32 refs=4.
payload.title: knowledge-vector-index --reference-id rebuilds lexical index for that subset only
